W.note: Glass pill with a pre-blurred glow that arrives fast and lingers on release via custom curves; very safe, legible, and cheap (opacity/transform only), but the effect is modest and the CTA is a ghost button.

X.note: Gradient hero pill with blurred bloom, orbiting halo, overshoot and slow exhale curves feels the most ethereal, with reduced-motion and focus handled, though long filter transitions and infinite loops cost a bit.

Y.note: Full-width light-theme CTA with drifting gradient wash, arrow slide and long soft settle looks lovely, but the white label loses contrast mid-hover as the surface washes pale.

Z.note: Careful layered timing with delayed glow tail and good focus/reduced-motion, but the showcased hover is a small secondary button with a faint blue smudge that reads more tidy than dreamlike.
